name: Novo Nordisk (NVO)
teaser: Novo Nordisk is still a very profitable company, and the stock is a notch above what I think the cash flow supports. At $40.65 it trades 14% above my Base value of $35.50, and the Base earns about 4.2% a year over five years. New money waits for $20.41 or less; existing holders can stay, with a review above $46.68.
llms: Novo Nordisk (NVO), Danish maker of Ozempic, Wegovy and the Wegovy pill, valued on ten years of free cash flow through the December 2032 US semaglutide patent expiry plus a justified forward earnings multiple. Bear $17.39 DCF, adopted Bear $20.13, Base $35.50, Bull $46.68. Price $40.65, upside -12.7%. Verdict Hold at $40.65, maximum buy price $20.41. Nine-month free cash flow DKK 83.8 billion against a full-year guide of DKK 60 to 70 billion.
